question: Indian Navy's Next Generation Stealth Frigate INS Nilgiri Docks In Chennai. Under which project was INS Nilgiri built?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Project 17A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian Navy's Next Generation Stealth Frigate INS Nilgiri Docks In Chennai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
INS Nilgiri is the lead ship of the Nilgiri Class stealth frigates.

 
 
• 
 
It sailed into Chennai harbour for the first time today.

 
 
• 
 
Built indigenously under Project 17A.

 
 
• 
 
Symbolizes India’s progress in naval and shipbuilding capabilities.

 
 
• 
 
Equipped with modern weapons and sensors.

 
 
• 
 
Enhances the Indian Navy’s operational strength.

 
 
• 
 
Commissioned by Prime Minister Modi on 15th January 2025.

 
 
• 
 
Named after the Nilgiri Hills in Tamil Nadu.

 
 
• 
 
Nilgiri district is home to the Defence Services Staff College.

 
 
• 
 
General Sam Manekshaw once resided in the Nilgiris.
